sloka: कुशलाः ते नर व्याघ्र येषाम् कुशलम् इच्चसि ।श्रीश्च त्वाम् वृणुते पद्मा युज्यताम् चापि ते रकः ॥२-७०-१२॥
transliteration: kuśalāḥ te nara vyāghra yeṣām kuśalam iccasi ।śrīśca tvām vṛṇute padmā yujyatām cāpi te rakaḥ ॥2-70-12॥

translations.english: O tiger among men (Bharata) those of whose welfare you are enquiring are all doing well. May the goddess of wealth and prosperity await you and let your chariot be yoked.
